info.title: Helper access – only for helpers of the tournament organisers
info.text: The tournament organisers must approve you before you can enter anything. Until then you only see the tournament name and date.

name.label: Your name
name.hint: 1 to 40 characters. The tournament organisers see your name with your request.
name.invalid: Please enter a name with 1 to 40 characters.

offline.title: You need a connection to join
offline.text: Your name stays in the field. Check the connection and try again.

authRateLimited.title: Too many sign-ins from this network – please try again in 2 minutes or use mobile data

unexpected.title: That did not work – please try again
unexpected.text: Your name stays in the field.

account.dialogText: You are signed in as {{name}}. Joining as helper signs you out on this device. Continue?
account.dialogTextNoName: You are signed in. Joining as helper signs you out on this device. Continue?
account.otherDevices: You stay signed in on your laptop and your other devices.
account.waitingTextCount_one: {{count}} entry from your own tournament is waiting on this device. It goes to the server under your account once the device has a connection. After that you can join as helper.
account.waitingTextCount_other: {{count}} entries from your own tournament are waiting on this device. They go to the server under your account once the device has a connection. After that you can join as helper.
account.waitingTextUnknown: Entries from your own tournament are waiting on this device. They go to the server under your account once the device has a connection. After that you can join as helper.

leader.title: You already run this tournament
leader.text: You are signed in as {{name}} and stay signed in. No request is created.
leader.textNoName: You are signed in and stay signed in. No request is created.

waiting.title: Waiting for approval by the tournament organisers
waiting.text: The tournament organisers see the same check number with your request. Until you are approved you cannot enter anything. Keep this page open.

invalidCode.title: This code is not valid
invalidCode.text: Scan the helper QR code of the tournament organisers again, completely.

codeRotated.title: This code is no longer valid
codeRotated.text: The tournament organisers created a new QR code. Please scan the current code.

codeExpired.title: This code has expired
codeExpired.text: The helper QR code is only valid until the end of the last tournament day.

tournamentClosed.title: The tournament is finished – joining is no longer possible

declined.title: Request declined
declined.text: The tournament organisers did not approve your request.
declined.hint: On this device you cannot make a new request until the tournament ends. If your request was declined by mistake, scan again with another browser or another device.
declined.hintRotated: Ask the tournament organisers for the current QR code.

requestExpired.title: Request expired
requestExpired.text: The code expired before the tournament organisers decided. Ask for the current QR code.

noAccess.title: You no longer have access
noAccess.text: The tournament organisers withdrew your access. Entering results is no longer possible on this device.

watchOnly.title: You can only watch now
watchOnly.text: You see the schedule and results, but you cannot enter anything any more.

finalStandings.title: The tournament is finished
finalStandings.text: You see the final standings. Entering results is no longer possible.

noRequest.title: You have no access to this tournament

busy.title: Too many open requests – please ask the tournament organisers

retryScan.title: Please scan again
retryScan.text: Something went wrong on this device.

offline.title: You need a connection to join
offline.text: Check the connection and then scan again.

unexpected.title: That did not work – please try again
unexpected.text: Scan the helper QR code again.

oldInvite.title: This invitation route no longer works – please use the helper QR code of the tournament organisers
